_comment: Gold-standard capture counts per test, from the Linux reference run (Linux is the baseline) with the readiness-beacon harness - all three OSes produce these same counts deterministically. copy_events is the total number of image copies logged; distinct_copies is how many were distinct (so duplicates = copy_events - distinct_copies). check_clipboard gates each OS's run against these: same screenshots (derived from the baseline frames), same copy events, same duplicate count, or the test fails. Refresh from a fresh Linux run if the recorded tests change.
